newsitem.title: USA: Peak Technologies pulls out of financing.
newsitem.headline: Peak Technologies pulls out of financing.

text.p: Peak Technologies Inc said on Thursday it has withdrawn from its previously announced financing deal, calling for US$3.0 million from Miami-based Select Capital Advisors Inc.

In a statement, Peak said "certain unresolved timing issues" made the deal unattractive. It added other financing opportunities have been presented to the company, and it will pursue those opportunities independently.
Peak is a software developer focused on Internet technologies.
